content.text:
Statement for Linked Answer Questions 57 and 58:
Air enters the combustor of a gas-turbine engine at a total temperature $T_0$ of $500\text{ K}$. The air stream is split into two parts: primary and secondary streams. The primary stream reacts with fuel supplied at a fuel-air ratio of $0.05$. The resulting combustion products are then mixed with the secondary air stream to obtain gas with total temperature of $1550\text{ K}$ at the turbine inlet. The fuel has a heating value of $42\text{ MJ/kg}$. The specific heats of air and combustion products are taken as $c_p = 1\text{ kJ/kg/K}$.
